Who this is for

The right fit for working together.

Enterprise SaaS teams

Product teams at B2B companies who have outgrown their current design capacity or are navigating a major platform evolution.

AI-first product companies

Teams building products where AI is a core capability — not a bolt-on feature — who need senior design perspective on the interaction and trust model.

Founders and growth-stage startups

Founders who need senior design judgment at a critical inflection point: entering enterprise, redesigning for scale, or shipping a new product line.

Design leaders

Heads of design and VP-level leaders who need a senior sounding board, workshop facilitation, or embedded capacity for a specific initiative.

How we get started

Simple, fast, no surprises.

The intake process is lightweight by design. I work with a limited number of clients, so every conversation starts with making sure I am the right person to help — before either of us commits to anything.

01

Reach out

Send a brief description of your product, your challenge, and what you are trying to accomplish. No deck required.

02

Discovery call

A 30-minute conversation to make sure we are aligned on the problem and that I am the right person to help. Fast and no-pressure.

03

Scope of work

I share an engagement recommendation — format, timeline, deliverables, and rate. Specific, not templated.

04

Kickoff

Once aligned, we start. The first session is always about listening — not showing you a direction before I understand the problem.
